role: independent visual outcome reviewer: silhouette and armor layering

goal.authority_limit: Architect-supervised authorization read from assigned local goal; cached origin/main predates that section.

decision_question: Retain body06 attempt02 as a net full-bird source-alignment geometry gain, or reject its wholesale armor replacement?
criteria: Visible full-character improvement against exact pinned locked composite
Distinct thin overlapping formed-metal leaves, compact folded shield-wing and coherent neck/breast transition
No source-likeness inference from payload, UV, build, or preservation checks
scope: Read-only review of frozen body06 attempt02 fixed renders, source, receipts and construction script. Separate root finish05 not judged. No worktree edits or artist acceptance.

source.worker_copy: Git LFS pointer; identical pinned binary viewed in architect checkout and hash verified; no reference substitution

retention: Reject wholesale body06 replacement as net source-likeness gain. Preserve version and selectively reuse smaller upper-covert scale and reduced horizontal cervical/breast shelf as ideas after overlap repair. Do not erase body05 or body06.
rationale: Body06 removes excessively flared large leaves and improves upper scale graduation, but most lower shield leaves collapse visually into a smooth teardrop cap and a broad plain breast/channel side band becomes dominant. Source has continuously legible separate rounded overlapping metal plates and embedded hardware. These regressions survive matched clay, grazing clay, inherited PBR and multiple turn angles. No full-bird net gain strong enough to promote this replacement.

visible_gains.claim: Finer shoulder-top coverts are closer to source scale than body05 large top leaves.
Abrupt transverse neck/breast collar shelf is reduced.

top_three_blockers.finding: Course tips and boundaries merge into a broad smooth shell, losing source formed-leaf rhythm. The thinner conforming geometry removes too much overlap shadow and distinct endpoint relief; this is visible even under grazing clay.
top_three_blockers.consequence: Full-bird folded wing reads as stylized smooth armor rather than dense layered metal plumage.
top_three_blockers.next_test: Same-camera clay/PBR whole and side views must retain each major lower course boundary and separated rounded tips without returning to body05 excessively flared leaves.

top_three_blockers.finding: Repeated triangular black holes remain between small coverts, and the coarse perimeter backing strip is visible. Source overlaps fill the shield crown with dense connected plates; the candidate has a perforated cap.
top_three_blockers.consequence: The scale gain is undermined by a regular hole lattice and unfinished shoulder coverage.
top_three_blockers.next_test: Grazing clay and hero views must eliminate regularly repeated upper inter-course voids through underlap coverage while keeping separate sheet contours.

top_three_blockers.finding: A broad unsegmented breast side band with three exposed cable runs and circular receivers dominates the hero view. The neck transition improves, but plate graduation collapses on this flank and folded shoulder stands apart from torso at front/rear angles. Source channel is narrower in image and surrounded by layered armor and dense embedded connections.
top_three_blockers.consequence: Body remains clean egg-like shell with ornamental cables rather than source interlocked armor/machinery construction.
top_three_blockers.next_test: After machinery06 integration, repeat hero and front/rear-quarter images; channel must read as recessed connected hardware bounded by segmented leaves, preserving receiver access and approved anchors.

exact_next_operator.name: shield pairwise overlap reconstruction
exact_next_operator.priority: before another global material pass or wholesale body06 integration
exact_next_operator.targets: scripts/cg-supervised-body06.py shield hierarchy leaf rows 00-11; especially rows 00-04 coverage and rows 05-11 free-end separation
exact_next_operator.operation: Keep shield section guide silhouette and small upper-coverts scale. Replace the common-envelope-following per-row offset with neighboring-sheet-aware placement: extend each covered root/side under the adjacent upper course, then offset its free end along the local section normal until the edge is distinct from the receiving lower sheet. Round and broaden the outline shoulder enough to close triangular holes; stagger endpoints along the folded-wing flow. Preserve thin edge thickness and compact overall envelope; do not regain separation by inflating the entire cap. Upper surface must sit above the actual receiver at overlap; avoid coincident tips that merge as shell seams.
exact_next_operator.code_evidence: Current shield guide uses off=.0038+(11-row)*.00030 and curvature=0 with gap=.0006; the independent leaves all conform almost to one guide envelope. This explains a plausible mechanism for the observed merger, not a proven measured contact analysis.
exact_next_operator.bounded_delivery: One focused shield-only native variant, paired existing whole/side/grazing cameras plus cropped-detail and uncropped eight-angle renders. Judge source resemblance before carrying breast or finish changes.
exact_next_operator.protected: head, stance anchors, machinery, existing receiving native, historical body05/body06; root finish05 remains separate
exact_next_operator.parameter_status: Specific displacements must be determined from observed sheet contact and source image; no source-derived millimeter measurements claimed.

claim_ledger.consequence: Wholesale promotion retains loss of plate layering.
claim_ledger.next_test: Shield overlap reconstruction compared to both body05 and body06 at identical views.

claim_ledger.claim: Smaller upper coverts and reduced collar shelf are useful local gains.
claim_ledger.consequence: Wholesale rejection could discard a useful direction.
claim_ledger.next_test: Retain their scale/transition while closing voids and restoring relief.

claim_ledger.consequence: Technical pass mistaken for creative acceptance.

evidence_limits: One independent role only; parent owns concordance, conditional disruption and adjudication. No child reviewers spawned.
Shared assigned source set and runtime model family may correlate reviewers; judgment remains subjective analytical image review.
Camera04 global35 hypothesis is estimated, not source calibrated. Exact before/after cameras and lights match; source alignment is not metrically calibrated.
All twenty render hashes and six before/after camera-light dictionaries independently checked. Native hash checked; no independent Blender payload/readback audit performed.
Turntable frames crop crown and feet; they support torso/shoulder-angle review, not complete full-character silhouette or posture acceptance.
Raw inherited PBR awaits root rerouting. Green matte response and illuminated builder optic are not judged as final era finish; clay evidence separates layering regression from those limitations.
No corrected browser export, WebGL/fallback, build/CI/deployment, animation, full three-era render set, First Choice frame comparison, engineering or owner artistic acceptance reviewed.
review_expiry: New geometry or root integration with changed armor visibility/material routing requires new matched-image review.
